recommendation.reason: Agentic, real repository tasks, executable scoring with 36.25% best; no blocking rule fires and Real, Solid and Difficult are strong.
risks: Release is partial: upstream task data and images must be fetched externally
Top controllers cluster within 2.5 points on full tasks, limiting top-end resolution

release.quote: **October 14, 2026:** We expanded LoopArena from 90 to **160 Type I questions** and from 27 to **80 paired Type II/III coding tasks**. The coding tasks span SCBench, BeyondSWE, and LoopsBench.

redistribution_questions: Third-party task material retains its own terms; which terms apply per source (SCBench, BeyondSWE, LoopsBench) is not stated here.
Large upstream repositories and container images are obtained from their original sources, so redistribution of pinned task data and images is not addressed.
rights.quote:
LoopArena code and documentation are licensed under [Apache-2.0](LICENSE).
Third-party task material retains its own terms; see
[third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

tasks.quote:
Type II and III are paired across **21 SCBench**, **29 BeyondSWE**, and
**30 LoopsBench** tasks.

verifier.full_credit: Source-native terminal evaluation must pass: LoopsBench all source unit tests pass ("pass_policy": "all-source-unit-tests-pass"), BeyondSWE reward equals one, and SCBench primary Core checks pass with protocol and budget validity required.
verifier.quote:
The coding settings retain Controller–Worker interaction and
use source-native terminal evaluation. For SCBench, the primary success
criterion is Core checks; protocol and budget validity are required for every
source.

oracle.quote:
No-control and fixed-control policies are reported as references;
they are not included in the Controller-model ranking.

services: Docker runtimes for Type II/III tasks
network_or_api: OpenAI-compatible model endpoint for the Controller (OPENAI_BASE_URL)
task container networks declared per case as "network": "bridge" or "network": "host"
exceptions: BeyondSWE formal evaluation must run in the live solve container after model access ends; a sealed workspace alone does not retain container runtime state
Type II/III require the pinned upstream task data, starting workspaces, and Docker runtimes, with large upstream repositories and container images obtained from their original sources
runtime.quote:
Type II/III require the pinned upstream task data, starting workspaces, and
Docker runtimes. Follow [data preparation and execution](docs/setup.md) for
source revisions, local paths, preparation commands, and single-case or panel
runs. Large upstream repositories and container images are obtained from their
original sources.
